title: PowerPoint: edit presentations with Copilot in GCC High
summary: The briefing accurately reports the disagreement between the roadmap and Microsoft's government-cloud availability table. Its licence requirement, assignment path and PowerShell command are supported; minor corrections concern the checklist's unrepresented group-membership check and a missing reference for licence-removal roles.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; rendered controls table
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses is the documented licence-assignment path.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence to a user.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Licence assignment requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Current product licence assignments can be reviewed under Billing > Licenses by selecting the product.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. If a license is assigned directly to a user, the user appears individually in the list of assignments for that product.

claims.claim: Members receiving group-based licence assignments can be inspected under Teams & groups > Active teams & groups.
claims.quote: To see which users are receiving the license through that group, go to the Teams & groups > Active teams & groups page to view its members.

claims.claim: Licences can be unassigned by selecting the product, selecting the users or groups and selecting Unassign licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page. Select a product. Select the check boxes of the users or groups for whom you want to unassign licenses. Select Unassign licenses.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist's group-membership control is represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: Checklist: "For group-based assignments, inspect the group's members under Teams & groups > Active teams & groups." Table: its sole row is "Which users hold the Microsoft 365 Copilot licence this capability requires", with only licence-assignment UI and automation.
claims.fix: Remove the sentence 'For group-based assignments, inspect the group's members under Teams & groups > Active teams & groups.' from Before rollout; it directs a separate group-membership check not represented in the controls table.

claims.claim: License Administrator or User Administrator can unassign licences.
claims.quote: Add or remove licenses for the user to enable or disable their use of Microsoft cloud offerings. The following least privileged roles are supported for this operation: Directory Writers; License Administrator; User Administrator.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/user-assignlicense?view=graph-rest-1.0 to sources as 'user: assignLicense'; it explicitly supports the licence-removal roles that the cited assignment article does not spell out.
